+::: .{note}
+Note that the [Affects Version/s]{.jbs-field} in general doesn't have a meaning for backports. The [Fix Version/s]{.jbs-field} indicates where the backport is targeted. To see what other releases are affected by an issue, look at the main issue.
+:::

It is extremely rare that you would set an issue to [Fixed]{.jbs-value} manually since the bots do this automatically when a change is integrated. If you for some reason do, the status should always be [Resolved]{.jbs-value}, never [Closed]{.jbs-value}.
